    Unbounded chains contain closed chains #

    In a finite ray category, a chain longer than twice the number of morphisms repeats one of its peak entries; the segment between two occurrences is a closed chain (RayCat.exists_closedChain). Hence an algebra with a twisted multiplicative basis over a finite ray category with unbounded chains is representation-infinite (RayCat.chainBounded_of_isRepresentationFinite).
